label: nyiso 70 scr edrp reserve
definition: nyiso-70 (CANDIDATE): nyiso-68 recipe + BOTH lever-3 reserve-supply unions on the energy+reserve co-opt — nyiso_hydro_reserve_eligible (step 1, conventional hydro into full 30-min + quick 10-min, East/NYCA) and the new nyiso_scr_edrp_reserve_eligible (step 2, the SENY tail): the downstate SCR/EDRP demand response already in the fleet ($500 strike, energy-only) is made eligible to SUPPLY the 30-min operating reserve, scoped to NYC + Long_Island + Lower_Hudson. SCR is a NYISO-certified 30-min operating-reserve provider (Ancillary Services Manual §4 / MST §15), so both unions are grounded market-design inputs (rule 1/13), ZERO new tunable (n_residual stays 5). The added downstate reserve headroom absorbs the SENY/NYC-30min ORDC over-spike that leaked into the 2023 LBMP: downstate reserve-shortage zone-hours collapse (2023 915->177, 2024 696->114, 2025 1215->255) and the >$300 downstate tail drops every year, while energy dispatch is essentially unchanged (|dTWh| < 0.09 per class, C1 fuel-mix PASS unchanged - reserve is held, not dispatched).
